comment: Who may appear as a contributor to this repository. GitHub builds the Contributors list from two independent things: the commit AUTHOR, and every Co-Authored-By trailer. Both are governed here. Anyone not matched is stripped (trailers) or reattributed (authors) by the commit-msg and pre-commit hooks and by Commit Attribution Guard. Matching is case-insensitive, and every condition an entry states must hold: a namePattern alone is never enough, because a display name is attacker-controlled. Entries naming a bot pin its email domain too.

allowedCoAuthors.label: Repository owner, GitHub noreply identity (appears in this repo's history)
Repository owner, Replit noreply identity (appears in this repo's history)
Jules (Google Labs) - the nightly pipeline's own agent, credited deliberately. Name AND email must both match: the name alone was a bypass.

allowedAuthors.label: Jules (Google Labs) - authors every nightly stage commit
GitHub Actions - authors the pipeline's own ledger, merge and sync commits. Removing this would break the nightly pipeline, not improve attribution.
GitHub's own merge/web-flow identity for squash and merge commits

reattributeTo.comment: A disallowed author is rewritten to this identity rather than the commit being rejected. The work was done on the owner's behalf, so the owner is who it belongs to.
